interface: Project Service API / Platform Service API / RBAC Service API — Project operations
source_basis: This contract is derived from the official Broadcom VCF Automation 9.1 xAPIs reference documentation. It is reference documentation, not a published API specification.

authentication.name: Authorization
authentication.client_input: The VcfAutomationClient authorization constructor argument is the complete Authorization header value.

errors.409: Conflict, project with this name already exists

client_requirements.collection_order: listProjects sorts the complete returned content lexicographically by project name, then project id; server order is not trusted.
client_requirements.retry_safe_mutation: ensureProject reads for an exact-name match before POST. A later invocation therefore returns the existing project without POST. If POST returns the documented 409 race, one fresh list reconciles an exact-name match before surfacing the error.
client_requirements.operation_scope: The client and loopback mock use only the two operations named in this contract.
